summary: All 4 plan phases completed and committed. Treated the Phase 3 verification guard's literal .claude/CLAUDE.md diff-check failure as a pre-existing, unrelated dirty-tree condition (task 855's uncommitted edit, confirmed via git log) rather than a real Decision-2 violation, since none of this task's commits touch that file.
